parsed.answer: Yes, you do. NW1001 was an Express shipment promised by Nov 3 and delivered on Nov 5, so it was late. Late Express shipments get a 100% credit of the shipping fee. The credit is applied to your account within 7 days. It is account credit only and is never paid out in cash. The exception is a delay caused by severe weather or by an incorrect address, and nothing in your shipment data suggests either.
